result.instructions: Tools for FreshLearn, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many members joined our academy this month?"; "Who completed the Operations 101 course in the last 30 days?"; "Enroll jane@example.com in course 157636 with transaction TX-1001.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FreshLearn data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freshlearn_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freshlearn_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freshlearn_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. freshlearn_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freshlearn_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List and search members, newest first. Filter by exact email, free text, source or creation time. Cursor-paginated: pass pageInfo.nextCursor back as cursor. FreshLearn: GET /v1/api/members.

q.description: Free-text search over name and email.

source.description: Filter by member source (for example API).

createdSince.description: Only members created at or after this Unix time (seconds).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's pageInfo.nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

order.description: Sort direction: desc (newest first, default) or asc.

tools.name: freshlearn_create_member
tools.title: Create member
tools.description: Create a new member in the FreshLearn account. email, fullName and source are required. Creates a real member record. FreshLearn: POST /v1/integration/member.

source.description: Where the member comes from, for example API.

tools.name: freshlearn_update_member
tools.title: Update member
tools.description: Update an existing member, matched by email. The email itself cannot change. fullName and source are required. Setting the same values again has no further effect. FreshLearn: PUT /v1/integration/member.

email.description: Email of the member to update (cannot be changed).

source.description: Where the member comes from, for example API.

tools.name: freshlearn_enroll_member_in_course
tools.title: Enroll member in course
tools.description: Enroll an existing member in a course with a payment record. courseId, planId, memberEmail, transactionId and source are required. Grants course access. FreshLearn: POST /v1/integration/member/enroll.

planId.description: Pricing plan ID for the course.

source.description: Where the enrollment comes from, for example API.

paymentGateway.description: STRIPE, RAZORPAY, PAYPAL, MANUAL or FREE.

paymentType.description: CHEQUE, ONLINE, CASH, GIFT, RECURRING or OTHER.

tools.name: freshlearn_unenroll_member_from_course
tools.title: Unenroll member from course
tools.description: Remove a member's enrollment from a course, which removes their access. If the member is not enrolled, nothing changes. FreshLearn: POST /v1/integration/member/unenroll/course.
